name: Iris Fold
description: Folded paper strips of the second clip slide in one after another around a shrinking polygonal hole, each turned a little from the last so their creased edges spiral inward, until the hole closes on the center. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: sides
params.description: Number of sides of the hole

params.name: rounds
params.description: Number of rounds of strips around the hole

params.name: twist
params.description: How much each strip turns from the one before, in radians

params.name: shading
params.description: Strength of the creases' highlights and of the strips' shadows
